groups.defect: ProvideAnonDBStore now takes an extra int64 deviceLimit argument, but pkg/server/wire.go still registers it as a provider and binds AnonStore to it. Nothing provides an int64, so wire generation fails and the server can't be built. The fix is to remove the stale provider and bind from wire.go, or to make the constructor take *setting.Cfg.

answer.reasoning: All three suggestions point at the same lines in database.go (52-54) and report the same defect: the ProvideAnonDBStore signature changed, but wire.go:374-375 still registers it and binds AnonStore to it. Wire can't supply the int64, so the build fails. All three propose the same fix: remove the entries from wire.go, or take *setting.Cfg instead. s_19d84151 also says wire would reject the provider for being unused. That is only another reason the same stale registration fails, and the same edit in wire.go fixes it, so it isn't a separate defect that needs its own edit. A single member's comment covers the whole fix, so needsUnifiedComment is false. That flag is the only borderline call here. Grouping all three together is clearly right.
